paper_defined: four add-one augmentation pairs ordered crop, color jitter, grayscale, blur, horizontal flip
four losses at ResNet stage boundaries
actual color-jitter parameter embedding before each projector
cifar10_adaptation_assumptions: ResNet-18 CIFAR backbone matches the existing fair harness rather than the paper's ImageNet ResNet-34/50
shallow adapters use 3x3 stride-2 Conv-BN-ReLU with channel doubling because kernels, channels, and strides were not published
augmentation embedding is 512-dimensional as published for ImageNet
projectors use the standard SimSiam 2048-dimensional output and each stage has its own predictor because HAI does not publish these dimensions or predictor-sharing details
CIFAR-10 data split and downstream evaluation follow the existing harness because no CIFAR protocol was published
